kjv: exercise authority upon, bring under the (have) power of

occurrences.text: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.
The wife hath not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body, but the wife.
